routines.name: Machine care
routines.prompt: /clean-up Flag only if free disk space is under 15%, if any single cleanup would free more than 5 GB, or if an app has used more than 50% CPU for a long time.

routines.name: Brand watch
routines.prompt: Search the web for the name youlytics and the youlytics logo wording. Ignore everything listed as Issam's own in business/ops/brand-watch.md and anything already listed there as seen. Flag only a site, profile or company that uses the name or brand without being Issam's. Add any new finding to the 'Seen' list in that file.

routines.name: Domain scout
routines.prompt: For every domain in the 'Wanted' list of business/ops/domains.md, check with whois whether it is registered. Flag only a wanted domain that is now available, or one whose expiry date is within 30 days. Update the 'Last checked' line in that file.

routines.name: Daily inbox digest
routines.prompt: Using Gmail, list the email threads from the last 24 hours that need a reply or a decision from Issam, newest first: sender, subject, one line on what they want, and how urgent. Skip newsletters and notifications. End with the one thread to handle first.
routines.setup_note: Needs the Gmail connector in Claude Code. Run /mcp in Claude Code, copy the Gmail server name into allowed_tools as mcp__<name>, then enable.
